facts.fact: On 2026-06-17 the IMA and TIS Tech Angola signed a 12-month, USD 150 million contract for the Digitais Publicas project, whose critical computing component will support the public-sector interoperability platform so systems of different public services can exchange data.
facts.system: Projecto de Infra-estruturas Digitais Publicas (plataforma de interoperabilidade)

systems.system: Projecto de Infra-estruturas Digitais Publicas (plataforma de interoperabilidade)

AGO.note: The story names digital identity only as an aim of the project; it states no system that checks people against the national ID.
